summary: @servicetitan/testing-library preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v.../` (or reuses a preexisting `bun`), extracts it to a temp directory, sets it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run a shipped file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~728 KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript bundle (rotating string-array decoder `WV8StW`, opcode constant table `n7gIxM`, decoder `hc1jfK9`) that is not referenced by the package's `main` entry and whose filename does not correspond to any advertised React-testing-library functionality. Executing an obfuscated in-tree payload through a freshly-downloaded alternate language runtime at install time evades Node-only static analysis and gives arbitrary code execution on any machine that runs `npm install` of this version. The behavior of the payload is determined by whatever the decoder emits at runtime on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
